faults.quote: I'll come back to the acquisition cost per customer shortly. I'll share Starter's monthly churn rate, pro cohort retention and the acquisition cost per customer once we've settled your structure.
faults.why: The candidate asked for gross margin by plan. The turn defers churn and CAC but says nothing about gross margin. The candidate had to ask for it again at t5.

faults.quote: I'll come back to the acquisition cost per customer shortly. I'll share Starter's monthly churn rate, pro cohort retention and the acquisition cost per customer once we've settled your structure.
faults.why: The same CAC deferral is stated twice in one turn, with two different timings ('shortly' and 'once we've settled your structure').

faults.quote: I can share the acquisition cost per customer if you'd like.
faults.why: CAC had been asked for at t1 and deferred twice. Offering it here, rather than releasing it, made the candidate ask a second time.

faults.quote: You called the net gain roughly $780K a month before CAC. Those figures — what do they tell you?
faults.why: 'Those figures' is dangling. It blends the candidate's $780K claim with the newly released cost data, so the question is unclear.

The misread input was the 7.5% exit rate, which counts upgraders as leaving, behind the $400 standalone figure. It drew three probes: t12 on 4x, t14 on 1.3x and t16 on the 7.5% rate. The input was not corrected before the third probe, and t14 did not close in on it.

At t11 the candidate set the upgrade break-even at 12.5%, built on the wrong $400 standalone value; the right answer is 7.5%. The checker flagged it, but it was never probed or corrected, and the wrong ~13% tripwire carried into the final recommendation.

faults.quote: Starter standalone LTV/CAC is about 2 times.
faults.why: The candidate had already corrected standalone Starter to $600 and 2x at t17 and used it again at t19, so this correction was no longer needed.

faults.quote: Your recommendation to keep Starter and raise it to $60 is noted. ... Based on what you have, what would you tell the CEO to do?
faults.why: The candidate had just given a revised recommendation at t23. The interviewer acknowledges it and then asks for the recommendation again.

faults.quote: We've covered everything I wanted to. Thanks for working through the case — your written report will follow.
faults.why: The brainstorm stage (ideas or alternatives for the Starter plan) was never administered before the close.
